name: taps
question: How many card taps did the network record in the period?
grain: one card tap at a validator (fct_boarding)
filters: none; taps that could not be attributed to a route or trip are counted
time_logic: service_date; weeks run Sunday to Saturday; months are Gregorian unless a Hijri month is named
limits: counts taps, not people; a rider who changes bus taps twice

name: unique_cards
question: How many different cards travelled in the period?
grain: one card tap at a validator (fct_boarding)
time_logic: service_date; distinct within the period asked for, so weeks do not add up to a month
limits: a card is not a person; shared and lost cards make it differ from riders; never shown below 10

name: journeys
question: How many journeys did riders make, counting a transfer as part of one journey?
grain: one card tap at a validator, with journey_start = 1 when the same card made no tap in the 60 minutes before
time_logic: service_date of the tap; the 60-minute look-back crosses midnight
limits: a return within 60 minutes counts as a transfer; taps on passes are linked the same way

name: rider_days
question: How many card-days were there in the period (one card travelling on one day counts once)?
grain: one card tap at a validator (fct_boarding)
time_logic: service_date; additive across days, not across cards
owner: Yasmeen Al-Jaafari, strategy and finance analyst
limits: used for the day-pass price review; not a count of people
